title: Explicit lower-half-cell policy for typed prescribed-H_phreatic research
problem_statement: The admitted typed geometry has no z(n+1) sentinel, so legacy source text cannot source-bind the mode-1 branch for H_phreatic between the last node centre and the declared bottom face.
The current typed state classifier and the explicit-bottom-face candidate geometry therefore cannot both be cited as recovered legacy semantics in that interval.

initial_research_policy.name: EXPLICIT_GEOMETRY_GAP_EXCLUSION
initial_research_policy.inside_profile_admitted: H_phreatic >= bottom_node_center and below the top-boundary envelope, subject to the existing source-bound node-snap rules.
initial_research_policy.below_profile_admitted: H_phreatic <= bottom_face, with hbot=H_phreatic-bottom_face and LOW01-A/A2/D authority.
initial_research_policy.rule: No HLINK04 trial, LOW01-B claim, or source-equivalence claim may be made for a control inside the unadmitted gap.
initial_research_policy.rationale: Exclusion preserves declared geometry and avoids inventing historical sentinel semantics while allowing source-safe inside-profile and below-profile slices to be researched independently.

gates: Every frozen case receives the preregistered policy classification with no tolerance expansion or retuning.
UNADMITTED_GEOMETRY_GAP cases expose neither an inside-profile active-domain claim nor a below-profile hbot solve request.
BELOW_PROFILE_ADMITTED cases derive hbot only from the declared bottom face.
Repeating cases in reverse order produces identical policy objects.
The result explicitly states that exclusion is a bounded research-envelope decision, not recovered legacy source behavior.

effect_on_hlink04.research_activation: HLINK04 may later be activated only on the union of qualified inside-profile and below-profile slices, excluding the lower-half-cell gap.
effect_on_hlink04.production_nonclaim: This exclusion is not acceptable as a complete production groundwater-level boundary contract; the gap requires an independent geometric/physical derivation before production admission.

forbidden: do not silently classify the lower-half-cell gap using either node-centre or bottom-face policy as historical truth
do not smooth or interpolate across the excluded interval
next_if_pass: Record C2 as the bounded HLINK04 research-envelope policy.
Keep production mode-1 blocked on a complete lower-half-cell physical derivation.
After LOW01-A2/B/D qualify and C1 is characterized, reassess HLINK04 readiness only for controls outside the excluded gap.
